items.finding: The definition of Confidential Information is fully mutual and covers information disclosed by or on behalf of either Party.
items.quote: "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of either Party to the other Party or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date, including customer and portfolio data, credit models, product plans, pricing, technology architecture, methodologies, software, business processes, and all analyses, compilations, notes or other documents prepared by the Receiving Party that contain or reflect such information.

items.finding: Obligations of confidentiality, standard of care, and permitted purpose apply equally to each Receiving Party.
items.quote: Each Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating and, if applicable, performing the Proposed Transaction; (b) keep the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information confidential and not disclose it to any person other than its Representatives who need to know it and are bound by obligations at least as protective as this Agreement; (c) protect the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information with at least the degree of care it uses for its own confidential information of a similar nature, and in no event less than reasonable care; and (d) be responsible for any failure by its Representatives to comply with this Agreement.

items.finding: No unilateral or asymmetrical residual rights clause is present in the agreement.
items.quote: No licence under any intellectual property right of either Party is granted by this Agreement.

items.finding: Remedies and the right to seek injunctive relief are reciprocal and mutual between both parties, without unilateral indemnities.
items.quote: Each Party acknowledges that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy for a failure to comply with this Agreement, and that the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive relief or specific performance in addition to any other remedy available at law.

items.finding: The employee non-solicitation covenant is reciprocal, narrowly defined to contacts in connection with the transaction, includes standard carve-outs for general advertisements, and explicitly avoids non-compete restrictions.
items.quote: During the term of this Agreement and for twelve (12) months after its expiry or termination, neither Party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other Party with whom it had contact in connection with the Proposed Transaction.

items.finding: The agreement provides a definite term of two years with confidentiality survival limited to a fixed period of three years post-termination.
items.quote: This Agreement shall come into force on the Effective Date and shall continue for two (2) years unless terminated earlier by either Party on thirty (30) days' written notice. Each Party's obligations under this Agreement shall survive expiry or termination for three (3) years.
